mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have overcast skies with a temperature of 73 degrees, feeling like 76 at the Military Ridge State Trail, under a waning crescent moon.

The City of Verona has updated its engineering reports, which track infrastructure projects managed by AECOM. Also, residents can now sign up for the free tri-shaw bike program at the Senior Center or apply for seasonal recreation jobs online.
There is plenty to do this weekend, including live music at Bailey's Run and Lake Lou-ee today, the Girls Try Hockey event today, and Yoga at Insight Wellness tomorrow.
In a report covering incidents from July 27th through August 3rd, police noted that on July 31st, an officer conducted a stop that resulted in the driver being arrested for O W I.
Culver's is serving up Snickers Swirl as the flavor of the day today. They are open until 10 PM, so there is plenty of time to stop by and enjoy a treat.
